description: Searches the media library of the connected site for images and returns id, address, title and alt text. Read-only, it changes nothing. Use it when the host wants a picture somewhere (a page block with wi_change_webinar_page_block, or the host photo with wi_change_host_photo) and names it by what it shows instead of by its address. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers.

limit.description: How many images to return, 1-50. Default 10.

search.description: What the image shows or what it is called. Leave it out to list recent images.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

name: wi_find_media
title: Find an image in the media library
